assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: one square illustration for an English vocabulary memory card.
Exact target sense: {"word":"there","pos":"adv.","meaning":"在那里"}.
Primary request: illustrate a clearly indicated distant PLACE, meaning "at that place over there".
Scene: one child stands in the near foreground at the left, shown in three-quarter back view, looking and pointing with a fully extended arm across a broad visible gap toward a SMALL EMPTY PATCH OF GROUND far away at the right. A small soft coral oval ring painted flat on the ground marks only that distant standing place; its interior is empty. One simple broad hand-painted blue directional arrow begins beside the pointing hand and ends precisely inside that distant ground oval, reinforcing the indicated location. A narrow gently receding footpath gives clear near-versus-far perspective. The child remains nearby and still; there is no walking or travel action. The indicated place is much farther away than the child, separated by empty space. Do not place any object, building, tree, person or animal inside the distant target location: the focal meaning is WHERE, not WHICH OBJECT. Keep the ground treatment minimal.
Style/medium: innocent hand-painted gouache with subtle colored-pencil texture on warm off-white paper. Soft daylight, natural muted green, blue and coral.
Composition: square 1:1, one simple scene centered within the middle 70 percent, fully visible child, generous empty warm-paper margins. The long pointing gesture, distant oval of ground, and distance between them must remain legible at small card size.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, written labels, punctuation, speech bubbles, logos, watermarks, borders or card UI. No destination object, no maps or map pin, no ornate landscape, no multiple arrows.

assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: one square illustration for an English vocabulary memory card.
Exact target sense: {"word":"all","pos":"adj.","meaning":"所有的"}.
Primary request: illustrate ALL members of one finite group, with absolutely no one omitted.
Scene: a small friendly classroom vignette consisting of one semicircle of exactly five seated children and one teacher at the side. Every one of the five children has one arm raised high in the same clear enthusiastic answering gesture; not a single child's hand remains down. Their other hands rest on their laps. The children sit on five simple separate little stools, arranged so every face and every raised hand is fully visible without overlap. The teacher presents the ENTIRE semicircle with a broad open-palmed sweeping gesture and smiles toward all of them. A single softly hand-painted blue oval on the ground surrounds ALL FIVE CHILDREN AND THEIR STOOLS together as one complete group; no child is outside the oval. The teacher stands just outside at the side. The intended visual reading is "all of the children", not an individual, not a few, not most. The inclusive whole group with no exceptions must dominate the scene. Keep the teacher small and secondary.
Style/medium: innocent hand-painted gouache with subtle colored-pencil texture on warm off-white paper. Soft daylight, natural muted green, blue and coral; harmonious simple clothing colors.
Composition: square 1:1, one clear compact scene centered in the middle 70 percent with generous empty paper margins. The full group and all five identical raised-hand poses must read immediately at small card size.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, written labels, punctuation, speech bubbles, logos, watermarks, borders or card UI. No blackboard, books, room furniture, extra people, arrows, trophies or objects. No child missing a raised hand. No selectively emphasized individual.

assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: one square illustration for an English vocabulary memory card.
Exact target sense: {"word":"get","pos":"v.","meaning":"得到"}.
Primary request: unmistakably show RECEIVING AND NOW OBTAINING an item, with the recipient as the main subject.
Scene: a delighted child at the center-right has just received a small coral gift box tied with a simple blue ribbon. The gift is already firmly supported in BOTH OF THE CHILD'S HANDS, close against the child's chest; the child draws the gift inward toward their own body while looking down at it with surprised happy eyes. From the far left, only a secondary adult forearm and hand are visible, palm open and EMPTY, having just released the gift. There is a clear gap between the adult hand and the gift, and the adult is no longer touching it. One simple small blue hand-painted arrow travels from the empty adult hand toward the gift in the child's hands, with the arrowhead ending at the recipient. Ownership has transferred to the child. Make the receiving child's happy discovery and secure possession of the new item dominate. The child must never extend the gift toward somebody else.
Style/medium: innocent hand-painted gouache with subtle colored-pencil texture on warm off-white paper. Soft daylight, natural muted green, blue and coral.
Composition: square 1:1, one simple tightly related scene centered in the middle 70 percent, generous empty warm-paper margins, fully visible child and gift, child much more prominent than the secondary adult hand. Clear readable hands and transfer direction at small card size.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, written labels, punctuation, speech bubbles, logos, watermarks, borders or card UI. No money, shop, birthday cake, party decorations, additional gifts, clapping people, grabbing, thrown objects, reverse arrows or unrelated objects.

candidates.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: one square illustration for an English vocabulary memory card.
Exact target sense: {"word":"who","pos":"pron.","meaning":"谁"}.
Primary request: a wordless scene unmistakably asking about the IDENTITY OF A PERSON: "who is that person?".
Scene: three people only. At the left foreground, a curious child turns toward a familiar companion to ask a question. The questioning child has clearly raised questioning eyebrows, a gently puzzled open mouth, and one hand held palm-up in an asking gesture. With the other hand the child points directly toward the FACE of an unfamiliar adult standing a short distance apart on the right. The companion looks thoughtfully at the unfamiliar adult with a finger at their chin, as if considering who that person is. The unfamiliar adult stands quietly and neutrally, fully visible, doing no other activity and holding nothing. The asking child's gaze goes toward the companion while the pointing finger identifies the separate stranger. Make the triad relationship visually clear: questioner, person being asked, unknown person whose identity is being asked. The subject of the question is visibly a PERSON, not any object or place. No waving or greetings.
Style/medium: innocent hand-painted gouache with subtle colored-pencil texture on warm off-white paper. Soft daylight, natural muted green, blue and coral.
Composition: square 1:1, a simple tightly related human vignette centered in the middle 70 percent, generous empty warm-paper margins, fully visible figures, expressive readable faces and simple anatomically clear hands.
Constraints: absolutely no text, letters, numbers, written labels, punctuation including question marks, speech or thought bubbles, logos, watermarks, borders or card UI. No objects, arrows, portrait cards, signs, scenery, mystery costume, or detective props.
